name: intercom
description: Phone-to-Volumio one-way intercom broadcast with playback interrupt and restore

volumio_info.details: One-way phone-to-Volumio intercom broadcast. Open the intercom page on your phone, press Start, and your voice is streamed live to Volumio — interrupting any current playback. Playback is automatically restored when the broadcast ends.
volumio_info.changelog: v1.0.0 - Initial release: one-way broadcast, playback interrupt and best-effort restore
